description: This file defines the custom exception class GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException, which indicates that an authentication provider (e.g., IM3) was unavailable. It includes static factory methods for creating instances from messages and JSON objects, and a nested Builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception related to unavailable authentication providers. It includes static methods for creation and a nested Builder class.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException, with a fluent API.
